card.name: "with" before contrast in imaging studies
card.fires_on: The word "with" in the phrase "Radiological Studies with Contrast" in metformin-type labels, where "contrast" comes next. Weaker on "vascular" in "intravascular iodinated contrast agents".

modes.label: with before Contrast
modes.description: The word "with" right after "Radiological Studies" or "radiological studies", just before "contrast".
modes.example: Radiological Studies<< with>> Contrast: Administration of intravascular iod

modes.label: Inside intravascular
modes.description: The middle of "intravascular" in the sentence on iodinated contrast agents.
modes.example: Radiological Studies with Contrast: Administration of intrav<<ascular>> iodinated contrast agents in metformin

card.writes: It pushes the model toward predicting "contrast" or ink and paint-like words next.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say "contrast", as in imaging studies with contrast dye.
